content: We rolled out an AI coding agent to three teams this quarter. The surprise was not the code quality but the onboarding: people needed a clear spec habit first. Curious how others handled it.

comments.author: Ben Achterberg
comments.text: Same experience. Specs first, agent second.

comments.author: Marta Ollendorf
comments.text: Exactly, the agent amplifies whatever habit you already have.

content: Which AI coding agent has the best integrations with existing CI? We are evaluating Shipwright and two others and CI fit is our main criterion.
Pricing for AI coding agents is all over the place. Per seat, per run, per token. What model do you prefer as a buyer?

comments.author: Ines Carvalhal
comments.text: That is the most common answer so far.

content: Six weeks with Shipwright on a regulated project. The traceability from requirement to test is what got it past our compliance review.
